title: Chat never fails while any provider answers: worker door chain with failover, embeddings and judge failover
body:
Owner, 2026-10-09: every production chat failed with "We couldn't answer this time": the chat worker's primary (stealth/space-bunny-alpha on OpenRouter) answered 404 "No endpoints found" and its one fallback (Vercel AI Gateway) answered 402 insufficient_funds. Hot-fixed by pointing CODER_DOOR_URL at OpenRouter.

Build real failover:
- The chat worker tries an ordered chain of doors/models (our inference gateway first when reachable, then direct OpenRouter and Vercel doors) and fails over on any failure before the first token (402, 401/403, 404, 429, 5xx, timeouts, connection errors), with a per-attempt first-word deadline.
- Embeddings (product KB, Gym records, codebase) and the Jev judge fail over across providers too, never fatal.
- Replace the retired primary with a live model; a 404 (model gone) benches that door for a while.
- Tests with fake doors (402, then 404, then success → answered; all fail → plain failure; per-attempt deadlines); a log line naming each switch.
- Deploy to production and verify, including a forced failover.

Related: #11132 (the visible "switched provider" note on web and Coder).
